skill.summary: 1688采购询盘寻源能力。当用户有模糊的采购需求但尚未选定具体商品时，通过描述商品名称、数量和需求，发起采购询盘任务，由平台匹配合适的供应商和报价方案。 核心定位：采购前的询盘寻源阶段，帮助用户将模糊的采购意向转化为结构化询盘，获取供应商报价。 触发词：询盘、询价、寻源、采购咨询、发布采购需求、我有一批XX要采购...

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of 1688-sourcing-inquiry skill:

- Enables users to submit sourcing inquiries based on product name, quantity, and requirements when no specific product is selected.
- Transforms vague procurement intent into structured inquiries to match suppliers and get quotations from the 1688 platform.
- Skill triggers only for explicit sourcing, inquiry, or quote requests with vague needs and no specific product or supplier chosen.
- Strict boundaries and integration with related skills: browsing triggers 1688-product-find, order placement triggers 1688-order, supplier search triggers 1688-source-suppliers.
- Provides clear parameter extraction and prompts users to fill missing fields (product name, quantity, requirements) before submitting an inquiry.
- Includes robust error handling and strict prohibitions on fabricating sourcing info or misusing the skill outside its defined scope.
